methods: Python standard library ZIP/CRC/SHA, JSON and AST inspection
Independent source review of MPC and vision findings; corrected scope wording
Independent recomputation from ten raw MPC feedback arrays
Project scrub_log patterns checked on durable text copies and frozen source ZIP members

git diff --cached --check passed for authored documents/metadata and new START_HERE; preserved historical-log whitespace warnings are recorded separately. Staged paths were checked against the exact authorized scope.

checks.note: All members were streamed with CRC and length checks during receipt; final check rehashes original ZIP without repeating decompression.
AST parsing only; received modules were never executed or imported.

checks.scope: Current project scrub_log patterns, including frozen source ZIP text members; not an exhaustive secret scan.

sha256_manifest: SHA256SUMS; generated last, excludes itself; run shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS from this directory
limitations: Does not compile ROS or validate deployed binary/configuration identity.
Does not execute received scripts or run SDK, motion, simulation, or the whole repository test suite.
Historical runtime files missing from run hash maps cannot be retroactively authenticated.

git_diff_check.policy: Whitespace present in received historical log bytes is preserved, not reformatted to silence diff warnings. All reported warnings are under logs/.
